headline.purpose: Page heading of a plain page and the owner page.

title.purpose: The "Nothing here" heading, a confirm's title, the heading of an owner section's inspector.

body.purpose: The app's body size: descriptions, empty-stage lines.

body-strong.purpose: Member and room names, section titles, button labels, the room name in the bar header.

label.purpose: People headings, counts, captions, share kinds, small buttons, tooltips.

mark-tag.purpose: The "720p" mark on a caption, in tabular figures: the one size between label and key hint.

key-hint.purpose: Keyboard hints only, in tooltips; never inside a button.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The one shadow (`--lift`, `shadow-lift`), the tooltip's soft drop: lifts what floats off what it covers. Tooltips, the You Menu, the confirms, the floating screen notice, "Reconnecting…" and "Click for sound".

shadows.name: eye-cutout
shadows.purpose: Cuts the avatar's eye dot out of the colour behind it.

shadows.name: away-outline
shadows.purpose: The empty circle of an absent member's avatar.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing: the eye lighting, tiles arriving, the mark passing its dot.

motion.name: colour-change
motion.purpose: Hover and state colour transitions on rows, buttons and inputs.

motion.name: eye-light
motion.purpose: The eye dot lighting on a followed member's avatar.

motion.name: tile-arrive
motion.purpose: A share arriving on the stage.

motion.name: mark-pass
motion.value: 1.2s loop, each dot lit for a third
motion.purpose: The mark as the small loader, in the loading slot.

motion.name: notice-arrive
motion.value: 180ms fade, rising 4px (settling 4px down from above at the stage's top)
motion.purpose: The screen notice, the hand-over offer, sharer notes and "Click for sound" rise; "Reconnecting…", the usage budget strip and the stage's top pills settle down.

motion.name: reconnecting-breath
motion.value: a slow alternation between full and 40% opacity (held at 55% under reduced motion)
motion.purpose: A reconnecting member's avatar and a reconnecting share's icon.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled button on a surface: Share screen in the room, Join on the invite page.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect width="20" height="14" x="2" y="3" rx="2"/><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="21" y2="21"/><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="17" y2="21"/></svg>Share screen</button>

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Stop Button

components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 272px; height: 32px; padding: 0 2px 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--soft, #b9b9bf); font: 500 13px/19px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-row:hover, .ds-row-followed { background: var(--raised, #18181b); color: var(--fg, #ececee); } .ds-row-away { color: var(--dim, #808087); font-weight: 400; } .ds-row-away:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--dim, #808087); } .ds-name { flex: 1; } .ds-avatar { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--raised-2, #232326); color: var(--soft, #b9b9bf); font: 600 10px/1 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-avatar-away { background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--raised-2, #232326); color: var(--dim, #808087); } .ds-eye { position: absolute; right: -2px; bottom: -2px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--eye, #62d2de); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--raised, #18181b); } .ds-share { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--faint, #6b6b72); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-share svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-share:hover { background: var(--raised-2, #232326); color: var(--fg, #ececee); } .ds-share-watched, .ds-share-watched:hover { color: var(--eye, #62d2de); } .ds-share:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--dim, #808087); }

components.name: Stage with Tile
components.description: The inset stage panel holding a watched share: a 16:9 frame with the picture at its own aspect inside on the letterbox (a portrait window sits between bars), captioned with name and kind.
components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--stage, #111113); } .ds-tile { display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 320px; margin: 0; animation: ds-arrive 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-picture { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--letterbox, #050506); } .ds-tile figcaption { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; height: 20px; padding: 0 2px; } .ds-tile-name { color: var(--soft, #b9b9bf); font: 500 13px/19px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-tile-kind { color: var(--dim, #808087); font: 400 12px/16px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } @keyframes ds-arrive { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.985); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tile { animation: none; } } .ds-picture { display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-feed { height: 100%; aspect-ratio: 9 / 16; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #3a3a3f, #18181b); }

components.css: .ds-you-menu { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 224px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--raised, #18181b); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); font: 400 14px/20px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-you-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px; } .ds-you-head span:last-child { display: grid; } .ds-you-head b { color: var(--fg, #ececee); font-weight: 500; } .ds-you-head small, .ds-you-label { color: var(--dim, #808087); font-size: 12px; } .ds-you-label { padding: 4px 8px 2px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-you-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--raised-2, #232326); color: var(--soft, #b9b9bf); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-you-item { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--soft, #b9b9bf); } .ds-you-on { background: var(--raised-2, #232326); color: var(--fg, #ececee); } .ds-you-menu hr { margin: 4px; border: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--raised-2, #232326); }

components.name: The Mark
components.description: Three grey sisters, the middle lit with the eye; as the loader it passes the lit dot along.
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-mark i { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mark-dot, #2e2e33); } .ds-mark i:nth-child(2) { background: var(--eye, #62d2de); } .ds-mark-loading i { animation: ds-pass 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; } .ds-mark-loading i:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: -0.8s; } .ds-mark-loading i:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: -0.4s; } @keyframes ds-pass { 0%, 100% { background: var(--mark-dot, #2e2e33); } 8%, 30% { background: var(--eye, #62d2de); } 42% { background: var(--mark-dot, #2e2e33); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mark-loading i { animation: none; } }

components.name: Remove (removal modal)
components.description: In a confirm whose one job is to remove, the destructive action rests in the stop tint (14% behind stop text, 22% on hover), with a ghost Cancel beside it holding the focus.
components.css: .ds-confirm-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; } .ds-btn-cancel, .ds-btn-remove { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 13px/19px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-cancel { background: transparent; color: var(--muted-text, #8e8e95); } .ds-btn-cancel:hover { background: var(--raised, #18181b); color: var(--fg, #ececee); } .ds-btn-remove { min-width: 80px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stop, #f26d6d) 14%, transparent); color: var(--stop, #f26d6d); } .ds-btn-remove:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stop, #f26d6d) 22%, transparent); } .ds-btn-cancel:focus-visible, .ds-btn-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dim, #808087); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
graeae is named for the three sisters who share one eye, and the interface is built the same way: everything is grey, and the single colour in it is the eye, which means "watching" and nothing else. It is Linear/Vercel minimalism taken all the way. Nothing is decorated; the order, spacing and cohesion of plain elements carry the identity, and the shares (the pictures people are showing each other) supply every other colour on the screen.

The density is that of a desktop tool left open for hours beside a game or as a watch party: a 13px body, 32px rows, a 288px bar of people and an inset stage that takes everything else. Surfaces separate by tone, never by lines. Motion is short and quiet (150ms colour changes, a 220ms eye that lights, a 240ms tile arrival) and every animation stops under reduced motion.

Dark is first and the default; a light mode is offered on the "You" page (Dark / Light / Match system), stored per device and applied before first paint. A theme is one block of the semantic tokens under its own selector; components never name a colour directly. A second theme ("Midnight Broadcast", `.impeccable/reference/later-theme-midnight-broadcast.html`) is planned for later and is not built; it must arrive as another token block, not as component changes.

Rejected by the owner: squarish shapes, decorative drawings that do no job, cursive or "fake creativity" type, and a brand accent sprayed over every control.
keyCharacteristics: Greys for every surface and every word; three colours, each with exactly one meaning.
Tone, not borders: ground, inset stage, raised rows and controls.
Geist for everything; Geist Mono only for keyboard hints.
Rounded everywhere: 6px controls, 8px shares, 12px stage, circles for avatars and the mark.
The mark: three grey dots, the middle one lit with the eye.

rules.name: The One Eye Rule
rules.body: The eye colour means "you are watching this" and appears nowhere else. If an element is not something being watched or the member being followed, it is grey.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Red is only ending or removing; amber is only a warning. A colour never decorates.

rules.name: The One Block Rule
rules.body: A theme is one block of the semantic tokens under its own selector. Components read tokens (`--ground`, `--raised`, `--eye`...), never hex values, so a new theme changes no component. The one literal is plain black in a `mask-image` (the bar's and the strip's fades), which carries alpha only and never shows as a colour.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Keys Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only on keyboard hints. Numbers use Geist with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Plain Words Rule
rules.body: No day of the week anywhere; only glossary terms (instance, owner, member, device, invite, room, access, present, share, live, watch, stage, usage, usage budget); no exclamation marks. Never user, account, stream, channel or session.

rules.name: The Tone Not Lines Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by tone, never by borders. The two 1px inset rings in the build sit on controls, not surfaces: the outline of an absent member's avatar (absence drawn as an empty circle) and the eye dot's 2px cut-out ring in the colour behind it. Inside one surface, a 1px raised-2 rule may divide what is read in order, never one surface from another: the lines of the Usage statement, and the inspector's actions from what they act on.

dos: **Do** keep every surface and every word grey; let the shares carry the colour.
**Do** use the eye only for what is being watched and the member being followed.
**Do** separate surfaces by tone: ground, inset stage (12px radius), raised rows and controls.
**Do** keep one filled button per surface.
**Do** read colours from the semantic tokens so a new theme is one block under its own selector.
**Do** name every icon-only button with a tooltip, including its key when it has one, and show a labelled button's key in its tooltip too, never beside its label.
**Do** stop every animation under reduced motion.
**Do** use glossary terms only, plain labels ("Forget", "Let back in", "Nothing here"), and no exclamation marks.
donts: **Don't** use the eye colour for buttons, links, focus, selection or decoration.
**Don't** use red for anything but ending or removing, or amber for anything but a warning.
**Don't** use square corners or squarish shapes.
**Don't** add decorative drawings that do no job.
**Don't** use cursive or novelty type, or any face besides Geist and Geist Mono.
**Don't** show a day of the week anywhere.
**Don't** draw a loading animation of your own; use `Loading.svelte`.
